title_zh: 香港金管局推出"ART"框架，支持银行负责任地使用AI
title_en: Hong Kong Monetary Authority launches "ART" framework to help banks use AI responsibly

paragraphs.zh: 10月15日，香港金融管理局（金管局）公布了一个新的"ART"框架，目的是支持银行业负责任地使用人工智能（AI）。"ART"代表三个词：可问责、有韧性和可信赖。也就是说，银行使用AI时，要清楚谁负责，系统要稳定，客户也要能够信任。
paragraphs.en: On October 15, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) announced a new "ART" framework, aimed at supporting the banking industry in using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly. "ART" stands for three words: Accountability, Resilience and Trust. In other words, when banks use AI, it must be clear who is responsible, the systems must be stable, and customers must be able to trust them.

paragraphs.zh: 根据这个框架，金管局发布了新的监管指引，并将和数码港、香港大学一起建设一个AI训练数据共享平台。这个平台把数据质量放在第一位。另外，金管局还发表了一份讨论文件，研究怎么监管"AI代理"，比如出了问题时，人可以及时介入。
paragraphs.en: Under this framework, the HKMA issued new supervisory guidance, and will work with Cyberport and the University of Hong Kong to build a shared platform for AI training data. The platform puts data quality first. In addition, the HKMA published a discussion paper on how to regulate "AI agents" - for example, making sure people can step in promptly when something goes wrong.

paragraphs.zh: 在第二期生成式AI沙盒测试中，超过60%的用例都在探索AI代理，也就是让AI在允许的范围内自己计划并完成多个步骤的任务。金管局副总裁阮国恒表示，AI从"生成式"走向"代理式"，是银行业创新的一个重要新阶段。
paragraphs.en: In the second phase of the generative AI sandbox tests, more than 60% of use cases were exploring AI agents - that is, letting AI plan and complete multi-step tasks on its own within an authorised scope. HKMA Deputy Chief Executive Arthur Yuen said that AI moving from "generative" to "agentic" is an important new stage of innovation for the banking industry.

paragraphs.zh: 这条消息说明，监管机构不只是限制AI，而是在帮银行找到安全使用AI的方法。对于亚洲其他市场的银行来说，香港的做法也很值得参考。
paragraphs.en: This news shows that regulators are not just restricting AI, but are helping banks find safe ways to use it. For banks in other Asian markets, Hong Kong's approach is also well worth looking at.

vocab.en: HKMA (short for 香港金融管理局)
agent (AI代理 = AI agent; 代理式 = agentic); acting/proxy

featured.note: the standard word for financial regulation. Collocations: 金融监管, 监管机构, 监管要求, 加强监管, 受到监管, 监管沙盒.

examples.zh: 金管局加强了对银行使用AI的监管。
examples.py: Jīnguǎnjú jiāqiángle duì yínháng shǐyòng AI de jiānguǎn.
examples.en: The HKMA has tightened its supervision of how banks use AI.

examples.zh: 这家超市的食品安全受到严格监管。
examples.py: Zhè jiā chāoshì de shípǐn ānquán shòudào yángé jiānguǎn.
examples.en: This supermarket's food safety is strictly regulated.

examples.py: Wǒmen xūyào bǎ xīn de jiānguǎn yāoqiú jiā jìn shùjù bàobiǎo lǐ.
examples.en: We need to add the new regulatory requirements into the data reports.
